articles.summary: iXCells Biotechnologies develops a diverse range of off-the-shelf and custom iPSC-derived cell models—sourced from both healthy and patient donors—with the goal of enabling “clinical-trials-in-a-plate.” The post iXCells Biotechnologies Launches iPSCore™ Platform for Generating Highly Characterized iPSC-derived Human Cell Models appeared first on iXCells .
articles.title: iXCells Biotechnologies Launches iPSCore™ Platform for Generating Highly Characterized iPSC-derived Human Cell Models
